assistant|one_shot_title: The created one-shot is titled "The Lost Temple of the Djinn"
assistant|one_shot_backstory: Ages ago the Djinn Zoltar justly ruled a vast treasure-filled temple, then disappeared and the temple was lost to the sands of time
assistant|one_shot_hook: A wealthy collector has hired the party to retrieve an artifact from the lost temple; he located it but lacks the power to retrieve it himself
assistant|one_shot_enemies_overview: The temple is filled with mummies, undead warriors, and constructs guarding its treasures
assistant|enemy_mummy_stats: 4 Mummies: Armor Class 11, Hit Points 45 (6d8 + 18), Speed 20 ft.
assistant|enemy_mummy_immunities: Mummies are immune to poison and psychic damage and to charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned conditions
assistant|enemy_mummy_trait_curse_of_the: Curse of the Pharaohs: touching the mummy or hitting it with melee within 5 ft. requires DC 15 Wisdom save or the target can't regain hit points and its hit point maximum is reduced by 10 (3d6) for 24 hours, until removed by remove curse
assistant|enemy_mummy_trait_mummy_rot: Mummy Rot: a creature hit by the mummy's Slam attack must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or be affected by the Mummy Rot disease (detailed in appendix A of the Monster Manual)
assistant|enemy_construct_guardian_stats: 2 Construct Guardians: Armor Class 17 (natural armor), Hit Points 110 (13d10 + 30), Speed 30 ft.
assistant|enemy_construct_guardian_trait: Construct Guardians have Immutable Form: immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form
Construct Guardians have Magic Resistance: advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects
Construct Guardians' weapon attacks are magical
Construct Guardians have Siege Monster: deal double damage to objects and structures
assistant|enemy_skeletal_warrior_stats: 6 Skeletal Warriors: Armor Class 12, Hit Points 22 (5d8), Speed 30 ft.
assistant|enemy_skeletal_warrior_trait_u: Undead Fortitude: if damage reduces the skeleton to 0 HP it makes a Constitution save with DC 5 + damage taken (unless radiant or a critical hit); on a success it drops to 1 HP instead
assistant|trap_pressure_plate_puzzle: Pressure Plate Puzzle: a room of floor pressure plates where the wrong plate triggers a poison dart trap; an Intelligence (Investigation) check DC 15 reveals which plates are safe
assistant|trap_spinning_blade: Spinning Blade Trap: a hallway of spinning blades that activate when the party steps on a pressure plate; avoided with a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check (DC 15, description cut off)
